The gate has an unmistakable open passage and two visually solid piers, allowing runtime collision to explain why the player can pass through the center but not the sides.

The tavern, infirmary, and merchant stall form a coherent city service set; the isolated sign establishes the wilderness-to-city wayfinding beat; the bed, stew, bread, and mug remain legible as one tavern service cluster.

The infirmary's large iron healing emblem is readable but should be reviewed in the finished city composition so it does not feel more modern or visually dominant than the setting.

The declared runtime heights are initial calibrated values. Mobile portrait captures must still prove the road sign and bed/food details remain readable without making the buildings dominate navigation space.
